name: planner-web-fluorophore-picker
objective: Replace manual entry of known Color-panel fluorophores with a complete library dropdown while retaining an explicit custom-entry path for genuinely new information and saving either choice into panel.channels.
invariants: Every valid non-family spectrum and every valid family variant appears exactly once in the picker.
Known selections save the library value into the active channel's fluorophore-bearing field; custom text is the only manually entered fluorophore data.
Tag-ligand channels write conjugateDye; all other conjugation modes write fluorophore.
Existing custom values remain visible/editable and existing known aliases resolve to a library selection without a destructive rewrite.
All writes read current store state inside the handler so sibling edits cannot be clobbered.
No commit or push occurs without separate user authorization.

tasks.title: Build the complete fluorophore option catalog
tasks.scope: Add a pure total catalog helper over the normalized spectra map. Emit every valid non-family canonical and every valid family variant exactly once with exact value, excitation/emission peaks, deterministic alphabetical order, and no mutation.
tasks.verification: Test synthetic malformed/family inputs plus the real loaded KB; prove uniqueness, deterministic ordering, representative ALEXA488/SYTO9/family entries, finite peaks, total degraded behavior, and no input mutation.

tasks.title: Create and wire the library/custom picker
tasks.scope: Render an accessible native select with all catalog options, an empty prompt, and a final explicit custom-entry choice. Show free text only in custom mode. Map existing known aliases to their library value, preserve existing custom text, and save changes through the active channel's current fluorophore-bearing field.
tasks.verification: Drive known selection, clear, custom reveal/type, existing custom reload, existing alias selection, tag-ligand write, ordinary fluorophore write, sibling target preservation, conjugation rerender, and accessibility labels in a deterministic DOM harness.

tasks.title: Verify the shipped picker artifact
tasks.scope: Run focused and full web tests, build tests, deterministic double build, no-fetch and duplicate-symbol checks, served-artifact freshness checks, and a frontier adversarial verifier. Fix every blocking finding and update handover/board state.
tasks.verification: Focused picker/catalog tests, full web suite, 24 build tests, two byte-identical builds, stable multi-request preview server, and gpt-5.6-sol high read-only adversarial review.
